|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Veers (V)]] (version 3 of 4). The image here is the Players Committee card image ([[:File:V6-D-Veers_(V)-2021-08-27-649630f.gif]]). The current text is [[Veers (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). * '''Original''' ([[Veers (V)]]): Virtual Set 6 release ([[Virtual Set 6]]); Players Committee card image<ref name="ht0">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/veers.gif veers.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit 022435b "Set 9 load", 8 July 2018.</ref>. Margin “•Veers”: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Leader. Once per game, if at a Hoth location, may ▲ Prepare For A Surface Attack, a [Hoth] combat vehicle, or an exterior marker site.” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Veers (V) (Errata)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="ht1">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/veers.gif veers.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit a5142dd "Tweak set images", 12 May 2020.</ref>: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Leader. Once per turn, may reveal from hand to ▼ 6th Marker or Blizzard 1 to Hoth. Deploys free aboard Blizzard 1. While piloting Blizzard 1, adds one destiny to total power.” '''What changed:''' “Once per game, if at a Hoth location, may ▲ Prepare For A Surface Attack, a [Hoth] combat vehicle, or an exterior marker site.” became “Once per turn, may reveal from hand to ▼ 6th Marker or Blizzard 1 to Hoth. Deploys free aboard Blizzard 1. While piloting Blizzard 1, adds one destiny to total power.” (the new sentence in italics, “6TH” with a raised “TH”); the margin lost its dot. The margin name and an “E” are printed in dark grey on the black strip and are barely visible. No errata sheet for this change has been found; the commit date, 12 May 2020 ("Tweak set images"), is the earliest proven date. Before/after: [[File:V6-D-Veers_(V)-compare-022435b-a5142dd.png|440px]]
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image, marked “E”<ref name="ht2">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/649630ff80dd241d266f2ee5b566324d6fb68448/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/veers.gif veers.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit 649630f "200: Added *E* where missing and updated some game text", 27 August 2021.</ref>: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Leader. Once per turn, may reveal from hand to ▼ 6th Marker or Blizzard 1 to Hoth. Deploys free aboard Blizzard 1. While piloting Blizzard 1, adds one destiny to total power.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same as PC-E1; a white “E” was added at bottom right, beside the dark grey one (commit message “Added *E* where missing”). A version because the change is visible on the card (Bill, 12 November 2026). The card prints the errata mark “E” although this is change 2 in release order: a PC transcription error in the mark (Bill, 12 November 2026: number versions by release order and record the printed mark). Before/after: [[File:V6-D-Veers_(V)-compare-a5142dd-649630f.png|440px]]
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Veers (V) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee card image, marked “E1”<ref name="ht3">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/eb9f1e88dd679e4fa7860bc7cc8b6032d3476e13/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/veers.gif veers.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit eb9f1e8 "V6 Remaster Part 2", 22 April 2024.</ref>: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Leader. Once per turn, may reveal from hand to ▼ 6th Marker or Blizzard 1 to Hoth. Deploys free aboard Blizzard 1. While piloting Blizzard 1, adds one destiny to total power.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same; the card was remastered: the errata mark became “E1”, the margin name is white, and the text box line breaks moved. The card prints the errata mark “E1” although this is change 3 in release order: a PC transcription error in the mark (Bill, 12 November 2026: number versions by release order and record the printed mark). This is the current text. Before/after: [[File:V6-D-Veers_(V)-compare-649630f-eb9f1e8.png|440px]]
